name: C
shortDescription: C gives a computer clear, detailed instructions. Learn with short programs that use words and numbers. A compiler turns your code into a program.

name: C++
shortDescription: C++ is used to make games and other fast programs. Start with small examples, then learn how to group values and reuse steps in your code.
highlights: Work with lists and simple classes

name: C#
shortDescription: C# is a language for building apps and games. Learn to print a message, work with values and write reusable steps. Try one small example at a time.

name: Java
shortDescription: Java is a language for making apps. Learn to store values, make choices and repeat steps. Start with a small program that prints a message.
highlights: Print a message and store values
Group data and actions in classes

name: Python
shortDescription: Python is a language for giving a computer instructions. Start with words, numbers and lists. Build small programs one step at a time.
highlights: Print words and work with numbers
Write steps you can use again

name: JavaScript
shortDescription: JavaScript makes things happen on a web page. Count points, change words and respond to a button click. Try small examples in your browser.
highlights: Make a button change a page

name: TypeScript
shortDescription: TypeScript checks the kinds of values in your JavaScript code. It can spot mix-ups before you run a program. Learn with small examples and clear steps.
highlights: Label values as text or numbers
Find type mistakes before running code

name: PHP
shortDescription: PHP is a language often used to build the part of a website that works on a server. Start with 12 small lessons, clear examples and practice questions.

name: Ruby
shortDescription: Ruby is a language for writing clear scripts and apps, including web apps. Start with 12 small lessons, clear examples and practice questions.

name: Go
shortDescription: Go is a language for small tools and fast network services. It checks types before a program runs. Start with 12 small lessons, clear examples and practice questions.

name: Rust
shortDescription: Rust is a language that checks many memory mistakes before a program runs. It is used for tools and fast systems. Start with 12 small lessons, clear examples and practice questions.

name: Swift
shortDescription: Swift is a language used for Apple apps and other programs. It has clear tools for values that may be missing. Start with 12 small lessons, clear examples and practice questions.

name: Kotlin
shortDescription: Kotlin is a language used for Android apps, server programs and small tools. Start with 12 small lessons, clear examples and practice questions.

name: Dart
shortDescription: Dart is a language used for apps and tools. Flutter uses Dart to build screens. Start with 12 small lessons, clear examples and practice questions.

name: R
shortDescription: R is a language for exploring numbers and data. It is useful for tables, summaries and charts. Start with 12 small lessons, clear examples and practice questions.

name: MATLAB
shortDescription: MATLAB works with numbers, rows and grids of data. A grid of numbers is called a matrix. Start with 12 small lessons, clear examples and practice questions.

name: Scala
shortDescription: Scala combines object tools with functions and strong types. It runs on the Java virtual machine. Start with 12 small lessons, clear examples and practice questions.

name: Perl
shortDescription: Perl is a language used for scripts, text processing and small automation jobs. Start with 12 small lessons, clear examples and practice questions.

name: Lua
shortDescription: Lua is a small language often placed inside games and other apps to let them run scripts. Start with 12 small lessons, clear examples and practice questions.

name: Haskell
shortDescription: Haskell is a language built around functions. It encourages making new values instead of changing old ones. Start with 12 small lessons, clear examples and practice questions.
highlights: Show that a value may be absent

name: Elixir
shortDescription: Elixir is a language that runs on the Erlang runtime. It is used for apps that handle many small tasks. Start with 12 small lessons, clear examples and practice questions.
highlights: Read steps from left to right

name: Erlang
shortDescription: Erlang is a language built for many small tasks that send messages. It is used in reliable network systems. Start with 12 small lessons, clear examples and practice questions.

name: Objective-C
shortDescription: Objective-C adds objects and messages to C. You may meet it when reading older Apple app code. Start with 12 small lessons, clear examples and practice questions.

name: Assembly
shortDescription: Assembly gives small instructions to a processor. These lessons use Linux exit codes to see simple results. Start with 12 small lessons, clear examples and practice questions.

name: COBOL
shortDescription: COBOL is a language often used in business systems. Its words describe data and steps in a detailed style. Start with 12 small lessons, clear examples and practice questions.

name: Fortran
shortDescription: Fortran is a language used for science and number-heavy work. It has strong tools for arrays. Start with 12 small lessons, clear examples and practice questions.
highlights: Change a value through a subroutine

name: Julia
shortDescription: Julia is a language for maths, data and general programming. It combines short code with fast number tools. Start with 12 small lessons, clear examples and practice questions.
highlights: Build a list with a rule

name: F#
shortDescription: F# is a language built around functions and clear data shapes. It works with the .NET tools. Start with 12 small lessons, clear examples and practice questions.

name: Groovy
shortDescription: Groovy is a language for Java-based tools, scripts and build tasks. It has short syntax for common jobs. Start with 12 small lessons, clear examples and practice questions.

name: Bash
shortDescription: Bash is a shell language. It is useful for joining commands and automating small terminal jobs. Start with 12 small lessons, clear examples and practice questions.

name: PowerShell
shortDescription: PowerShell is a shell and scripting language. Its pipelines can carry objects with named properties. Start with 12 small lessons, clear examples and practice questions.

name: Solidity
shortDescription: Solidity describes smart contracts. A smart contract is code stored and run by a blockchain system. Start with 12 small lessons, clear examples and practice questions.

name: SQL
shortDescription: SQL helps you find answers in tables of data. A table has rows and columns, like a class list. Practise asking questions about the data.

name: PL/SQL
shortDescription: PL/SQL adds variables, choices and loops to Oracle SQL. It is used to work with data inside an Oracle database. Start with 12 small lessons, clear examples and practice questions.

name: T-SQL
shortDescription: T-SQL is the SQL language used by Microsoft SQL Server. It adds variables and control steps to table queries. Start with 12 small lessons, clear examples and practice questions.
